symptom: A cold cloud resume spent 6.5 seconds in WorkspaceService.open metadata persistence and another 9.3 seconds in the same persistence during reconfiguration, although the saved workspace metadata was unchanged. The temp-file write and file/directory fsyncs blocked ENGINE_READY and the first workspace read on a restored disk.
rule: Principles 4, 13, 14 and 16: measure persistence through the real worker boundary, compare against confirmed serialized state inside the metadata queue, and keep every actual change durable before publication. Invalidate the saved comparison before write I/O: directory sync can fail after rename, so even a later request for the old state must repair disk.
